title: Bot HQ: In-Band MCP Tool Approval Gate
summary: Tool approvals execute in-band inside POST /mcp/<botId> so every engine and external messaging channel shares one safety boundary: read-only tools run immediately while write tools block on an interactive card (Allow, Always allow, Don't allow, skipped).
